sim_config.text:
# End-to-end PPO -> joint-position PD baseline: an exact recreation of
# unitreerobotics/unitree_rl_gym's Go2 task (GO2RoughCfg over LeggedRobotCfg,
# commit 276801e) on this project's MuJoCo Go2.
#
# The task semantics (commands, observation noise, rewards, termination,
# reset randomisation, legged_gym's push_robots, friction randomisation) live
# in the env: envpool/envpool/mujoco/gym/quadruped_pd.h.
# This file configures only what the simulator and control stack need.
#
# First trial: this project's own impulse sampler is OFF. The recipe's only
# external disturbance is legged_gym's push_robots, implemented in the env.
%include envpool.toml

[simulation]
external_force_enable = false

[control_parameters]
# The leg controller clamps at control rate and forwards the clamp residual as
# a feedforward torque. Unitree's law is clip(PD) evaluated at every physics
# step, so the clamp is moved entirely into MuJoCo's actuator force range (set
# per env from the Go2 URDF efforts, see the env) and this bound is lifted so
# the controller always sends a pure PD command with zero feedforward.
max_torque = [1000.0, 1000.0, 1000.0]

[rl_command_source]
# Commands are generated by the env exactly as legged_gym does (heading mode,
# 10 s resampling). The command source's own sampler would otherwise draw from
# std::random_device and make runs unrepeatable.
policy_random_velocity_enabled = false
policy_base_velocity = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]

[rl_joint_pd]
stiffness = 20.0
damping = 0.5
action_scale = 0.25
# GO2RoughCfg.init_state.default_joint_angles, mapped into this model's joint
# convention. Controller order is FR, FL, RR, RL, [abad, hip, knee] per leg.
# This MJCF's thigh and knee axes are (0, -1, 0) against the URDF's (0, 1, 0),
# with the same zero pose, so q_here = [q_hip, -q_thigh, -q_calf]:
#   URDF FR ( -0.1, 0.8, -1.5)  FL (0.1, 0.8, -1.5)
#        RR ( -0.1, 1.0, -1.5)  RL (0.1, 1.0, -1.5)
default_joint_positions = [
  -0.1, -0.8, 1.5,
   0.1, -0.8, 1.5,
  -0.1, -1.0, 1.5,
   0.1, -1.0, 1.5,
]

[logserver]
enabled = false
